section: 5/7/2025Amended by Chapter 302, 2025 General Session2025Court's power to relieve trustee from restrictions on powers and duties.This chapter does not affect the power of a court of competent jurisdiction for cause shown and upon petition of the trustee, attorney general, or affected beneficiary, and upon appropriate notice to the affected parties to relieve a trustee from any restrictions on the trustee's powers and duties that are placed upon the trustee by the governing instrument or applicable law.
